description: Machine-verifiable invariants — laws the system must always satisfy. Every invariant is checked automatically by scripts/verify-invariants.mjs in CI, the guardian, and the terminal. A violation BLOCKS implementation.

invariants.name: No merge conflict markers
invariants.description: No real conflict markers (<<<<<<< / ======= / >>>>>>> on their own line) in tracked source files
invariants.evidence: OPS-GIT-002 Rule 2 — corruption reached main twice, breaking all builds

invariants.name: Lockfile valid + in sync
invariants.description: package-lock.json parses and its root package matches package.json
invariants.evidence: Corrupted lockfile (60 markers) broke every Heroku deploy

invariants.name: No secrets in tracked files
invariants.description: verify-secret-hygiene passes — no credentials in source, name-only presence
invariants.evidence: Secret-safe workflow — secrets live only in Heroku config / ignored .env

invariants.name: Terminal integrity
invariants.description: apps/web/terminal.html has no conflict markers and contains the enterprise sections
invariants.evidence: Merge artifacts corrupted terminal.html; the terminal is the control plane

invariants.name: TypeScript 7 contract
invariants.description: No TypeScript 5.x or lower in direct constraints or resolved compiler entries
invariants.evidence: verify:typescript gate — TS7 native + TS6 API alias for eslint only

invariants.name: Pipeline integrity — 3 environments
invariants.description: kudbee-fuel-gage-dev, -staging, and -prod all exist on Heroku
invariants.evidence: Dev app was deleted silently; only 2 of 3 environments existed

invariants.name: Redis quota headroom
invariants.description: Polling intervals must stay under ~30% of the 500k monthly quota
invariants.evidence: Intervals were 164% of quota — hard-tuned to 23% (heartbeat 5min, audit 15min, BRPOP 25s)

invariants.name: No server-runtime vulnerabilities
invariants.description: Server-runtime dependencies (express, pg, ioredis, zod, upstash, genai) have zero known vulnerabilities. Expo mobile-toolchain xmldom (<=0.8.12) is a documented build-only exception pinned via overrides.
invariants.evidence: npm audit --omit=dev — all findings are @xmldom/xmldom in @expo/plist; server deps verified clean

invariants.name: Clean tree before mission
invariants.description: No uncommitted changes when starting or ending a mission
invariants.evidence: Dirty tree caused branch confusion and lost work across sessions

invariants.name: Active mission on roadmap
invariants.description: Roadmap has at least one in_progress or planned phase
invariants.evidence: No mission = no direction; every session should have a purpose
